US District Judge Jeffrey Kuntz rejected the broadcaster's request to throw out the core defamation allegation, determining that Trump had successfully presented a plausible argument that the network harmed his reputation and acted with knowledge or reckless disregard regarding the misleading nature of the edited video segment. The judge's preliminary ruling strictly addressed the viability of the complaint and did not constitute a final legal decision on the merits of whether Trump has formally proven his accusations. Expressing satisfaction with the development, Trump characterized the decision as a major triumph via a social media statement, asserting that he will maintain his efforts against entities attempting to deceive the public.

Representatives for the BBC expressed surprise regarding the judicial outcome while formally affirming respect for the authority of the court and maintaining confidence in their legal standing. The broadcaster previously acknowledged that the video alterations were misleading and offered an apology to Trump, though it continues to dispute any legal liability concerning defamation. The underlying lawsuit, initially launched in December within a Florida federal court, details how the network spliced disparate portions of a speech—including statements directing followers to march to the Capitol alongside remarks urging them to fight fiercely—while omitting sections where Trump explicitly advocated for peaceful demonstration.

The disputed video material originally appeared within a BBC "Panorama" documentary program aired shortly ahead of the 2024 presidential election, an election that Trump ultimately won. The editing controversy previously created a severe internal public relations challenge for the publicly funded British organization after a leaked memo highlighted the alterations as potential indicators of political bias, ultimately resulting in high-level resignations within the network.

stories.title: لارا سائیڈز کا ڈیمنشیا ٹیسٹ اور اس کے زندگی پر اثرات
stories.summary:
لارا سائیڈز کو ابتدائی عمر میں لاحق ہونے والی ڈیمنشیا کی نایاب قسم کا پتہ لگانے کے لیے ایک طبی ٹیسٹ کی پیشکش کی گئی۔ اس سے قبل ان کے والد کی بھی اسی بیماری کی تشخیص ہوئی تھی جب وہ 40 برس کے تھے، اور لارا نے اپنے والد کی شدید علامات کے دوران ان کی دیکھ بھال بھی کی تھی۔ والد کے انتقال کے بعد لارا نے دنیا کی سیر کی اور بالآخر آسٹریلیا کے شہر میلبورن میں سکونت اختیار کی۔ سنہ 2013 میں ایک طبی ماہر نے انھیں بتایا کہ ٹیسٹ کے ذریعے 99.999 فیصد یقین سے معلوم ہو سکتا ہے کہ آیا انھیں یہ جین ورثے میں ملا ہے یا نہیں۔

اپنی تیس کی دہائی میں داخل ہونے کے بعد لارا نے چھ ماہ کے مشاورتی عمل کے بعد بالآخر یہ ٹیسٹ کروانے کا فیصلہ کیا۔ چھ ہفتوں کے بعد جب نتائج آئے تو ڈاکٹروں نے انھیں بتایا کہ خبر اچھی نہیں ہے اور انھیں یہ جین ورثے میں ملا ہے جس کے بعد ان کی صحت میں تنزلی 46 سے 48 سال کی عمر کے درمیان شروع ہو سکتی ہے۔ ابتدا میں یہ اطلاع سن کر وہ الجھن اور غصے کا شکار ہوئیں اور انھیں لگا کہ یہ سخت ناانصافی ہے۔

تشخیص کے بعد لارا نے مختلف طبی آزمائشی پروگراموں میں حصہ لیا تاکہ اس منفی صورتحال میں کسی مثبت کام کا حصہ بن سکیں۔ اب ان کی عمر 43 سال ہے اور وہ اس عمر سے صرف تین سال دور ہیں جب ڈاکٹروں نے علامات ظاہر ہونے کی پیش گوئی کی تھی۔ لارا کو اس بات کا احساس ہوا کہ لوگ اس کے باوجود بھی ان سے محبت کر سکتے ہیں جس سے ان کے دل کو اطمینان ملا۔

اب وہ اپنی زندگی ان چھوٹی چھوٹی چیزوں اور پیاروں کے ساتھ گزارنا چاہتی ہیں جو انھیں خوشی دیتی ہیں۔ وہ فطرت سے محبت کرتی ہیں اور باہر وقت گزارنا پسند کرتی ہیں، اور امید کرتی ہیں کہ وہ شیمپین پیتے ہوئے اور اوئیسٹرز کھاتے ہوئے دنیا میں مزید کچھ خوبصورت برس گزار سکیں گی۔

stories.title: ایران اپنے افزودہ یورینیم کا ایک ذرہ بھی باہر نہیں جانے دے گا، محسن رضائی
stories.summary:
ایرانی سپریم نیشنل سکیورٹی کونسل کے سیکریٹری محسن رضائی نے اعلان کیا ہے کہ ایران اپنے افزودہ یورینیم کا ایک ذرہ بھی ملک سے باہر منتقل کرنے کی ہرگز اجازت نہیں دے گا۔ لبنانی میڈیا کو دیے گئے ایک انٹرویو میں انہوں نے واضح کیا کہ افزودہ یورینیم کا ذخیرہ ملک کے اندر ہی رہے گا اور اس کی بیرونِ ملک منتقلی کسی بھی صورت قبول نہیں کی جائے گی۔

محسن رضائی کا یہ بیان ایسے وقت میں سامنے آیا ہے جب ایران کے جوہری پروگرام اور افزودہ یورینیم کے ذخیرے کے معاملے پر کشیدگی پائی جاتی ہے۔ تہران اور واشنگٹن کے مابین جوہری تنازع پر اختلافات ہنوز برقرار ہیں، اور افزودہ یورینیم کا مستقبل دونوں فریقوں کے درمیان جاری مذاکرات کا ایک مرکزی نکتہ ہے۔

اپنے انٹرویو کے دوران ایرانی عہدیدار نے کسی بھی مخصوص معاہدے یا مذاکراتی تجویز کی تفصیلات فراہم نہیں کیں۔ تاحال اس مؤقف پر امریکا یا دیگر متعلقہ عالمی فریقوں کی طرف سے کوئی باضابطہ ردعمل سامنے نہیں آیا ہے۔

stories.title: Imran Khan undergoes eye procedure at Islamabad hospital
stories.summary:
Imran Khan, the founder of PTI and former prime minister, was transferred from Rawalpindi's Adiala jail to the Pakistan Institute of Medical Sciences in Islamabad for medical assessments and follow-up eye treatment. A hospital official reported that the ophthalmology department administered an intravitreal anti-VEGF injection following an ocular assessment. Officials confirmed his vital parameters were normal, he remained clinically stable throughout the procedure, and he was discharged around 2:30 am with instructions for continued care.

Imran has been imprisoned since August 2023, and his ongoing detention has raised concerns among party members regarding his declining health. His right central retinal vein occlusion came to light in late January, resulting in multiple hospital transfers. In August, the Supreme Court directed the government to shift him to Shifa International Hospital after a jail report and subsequent examinations by Pims medical boards highlighted complaints of fluctuating blood pressure, headaches, and restlessness.

The Supreme Court-ordered transfer to Shifa International Hospital was disrupted when the government diverted him to Pims instead, citing security challenges created by PTI workers along the route. While the government blamed party supporters for disrupting the transport, the PTI denied the accusations and accused authorities of deliberately ignoring judicial orders concerning his medical treatment.

stories.title: PM Shehbaz Sharif outlines Pakistan's climate priorities at COP31
stories.summary:
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif arrived in Turkiye to outline Pakistan's climate priorities at the COP31 Antalya Leaders' Summit. Delegations from nearly 200 countries gathered in Antalya as global greenhouse gas emissions persist alongside intersecting international crises. Speakers scheduled alongside the prime minister include Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva, European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen, Chinese Vice President Han Zheng, and Marshall Islands President Hilda Heine. The United States skipped the negotiations for the second consecutive year after President Donald Trump withdrew from climate cooperation.

The Prime Minister's Office stated that Shehbaz will emphasize the urgent need for enhanced global action and international cooperation to address climate change impacts. The Foreign Office added that he will highlight Pakistan's transition toward a cleaner economy through rapid solarisation, renewable energy expansion, and improved disaster preparedness. Furthermore, the prime minister will urge developed nations to provide predictable, adequate, and accessible climate finance to help developing countries build resilience.

On the summit's sidelines, PM Shehbaz is expected to hold bilateral meetings with Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan and other world leaders. He will also address a high-level dialogue on clean energy transition convened by the COP31 presidency. Meanwhile, ongoing negotiations face friction over demands by developing nations for increased funding platforms, while recent reports from the World Meteorological Organization indicate that 2026 continues a trend of extreme global temperatures and melting ice.

stories.title: برطانوی اداکار رسل برانڈ کو جنسی زیادتی پر قید، ایلون مسک کی حمایت
stories.summary:
برطانوی اداکار اور کامیڈین رسل برانڈ کو ایک عدالت کی جانب سے جنسی زیادتی اور حملوں کے مختلف الزامات میں مجرم قرار دے کر ساڑھے 10 سال قید کی سزا سنا دی گئی ہے۔ عدالت نے انہیں ایک خاتون سے زیادتی اور تین جنسی حملوں کے الزامات میں سزا دی جبکہ دو دیگر زیادتی سمیت تین الزامات سے بری کر دیا۔ مقدمے کی کارروائی کے دوران رسل برانڈ مسلسل اپنے اوپر لگائے گئے الزامات کی تردید کرتے رہے ہیں۔

عدالتی فیصلے کے بعد معروف امریکی کاروباری شخصیت ایلون مسک نے سوشل میڈیا پلیٹ فارم ایکس پر ردعمل ظاہر کرتے ہوئے رسل برانڈ کی حمایت کی اور عدالتی فیصلے پر سوالات اٹھائے۔ ایلون مسک نے مقدمے میں استعمال کیے جانے والے قانونی معیار کو عجیب قرار دیا۔

یاد رہے کہ اس سے قبل امریکی ٹی وی میزبان میگن کیلی بھی اس مقدمے میں جیوری کے فیصلے پر اپنے عدم اعتماد کا اظہار کر چکی ہیں۔ برطانوی عدالت کی جانب سے سنائی جانے والی اس سزا پر عوامی اور سماجی حلقوں میں مختلف تبصرے کیے جا رہے ہیں۔

stories.title: UNHCR announces professional international career opportunities for Pakistanis
stories.summary:
The Bureau of Emigration and Overseas Employment in Islamabad announced international career opportunities offered by the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees for highly educated professionals. The UNHCR provides diverse professional pathways across specialized humanitarian sectors, including legal protection, emergency preparedness, community services, public health, livelihoods, and programme management.

The agency focuses on safeguarding refugees, internally displaced persons, and stateless individuals while advocating for fundamental human rights and access to essential services globally. This recruitment initiative highlights the value of international professional engagement and encourages qualified Pakistani experts to contribute their skills to worldwide humanitarian initiatives.

Interested candidates seeking to participate in these global efforts can review available vacancies, specific eligibility criteria, and application guidelines directly through the official UNHCR careers portal.

stories.title: Asian Development Bank Approves $500 Million Disaster Financing for Pakistan
stories.summary:
The Asian Development Bank (ADB) approved $500 million in contingent disaster financing facilities for Pakistan on Wednesday. The funds are designed to provide prompt budgetary support following eligible natural disasters and aim to mitigate the economic and fiscal fallout from events like floods and earthquakes. According to ADB estimates, natural disasters cost Pakistan an average of $2 billion annually. The bank highlighted that the devastating floods of 2022 alone resulted in $14.9 billion in direct damage, caused $15.2 billion in economic losses, and pushed approximately 9.1 million individuals into poverty, disproportionately impacting rural communities, the poor, women, and girls.

This new financing falls under the second subprogramme of the Climate and Disaster Resilience Enhancement Programme, which supports governmental reforms aimed at boosting disaster preparedness, enhancing risk management, and integrating resilience into national development planning and investments. ADB Country Director for Pakistan Emma Fan emphasized the importance of investing in preparedness to protect lives, livelihoods, and development gains, especially for vulnerable populations. The initiative aligns with Pakistan's risk management priorities and the bank's broader strategy for the Asia-Pacific region. Previously, the ADB approved a similar $500 million policy-based loan in October 2024 to strengthen the country's disaster planning and response capacities, while the government sought an additional $1 billion in April under the programme's second tranche.

Despite these international efforts, Pakistan's disaster preparedness has encountered hurdles, such as delays in implementing the Fourth National Flood Protection Plan due to difficulties in securing required funding from domestic and international partners, including the ADB, the World Bank, and the Japan International Cooperation Agency. The plan was originally formulated to enhance protection for homes, agricultural lands, and critical infrastructure in the aftermath of the 2022 floods. The newly approved ADB financing seeks to address these systemic vulnerabilities by improving the availability of post-disaster funds and strengthening the nation's overall disaster risk financing framework.

stories.title: پاکستانی برآمدات میں بڑی کمی، خلیجی ممالک کو ہونے والی تجارت متاثر
stories.summary:
پاکستان اور خلیجی ممالک کے درمیان تجارت کے حوالے سے جاری کردہ تازہ اعداد و شمار کے مطابق ایران امریکا تنازع کے اثرات کی وجہ سے خلیجی ممالک کو ہونے والی پاکستانی برآمدات میں نمایاں کمی ریکارڈ کی گئی ہے۔ دستیاب سرکاری دستاویزات سے ظاہر ہوتا ہے کہ مارچ سے جون 2026 کے دوران خلیجی ممالک کے لیے برآمدات میں 32.3 فیصد کی بڑی کمی واقع ہوئی۔

رپورٹ کے مطابق مارچ سے جون 2025 کے دوران خلیجی ممالک کو پاکستان کی کُل برآمدات 98 کروڑ 6 لاکھ ڈالر تھیں، جو رواں سال اسی مدت میں گھٹ کر 66 کروڑ 37 لاکھ ڈالر رہ گئیں۔ اس کے علاوہ جولائی سے اکتوبر 2026 کے دوران بھی برآمدات میں گزشتہ سال کے مقابلے میں 6.4 فیصد کمی ہوئی، جس کے بعد یہ حجم 1 ارب 88 کروڑ 90 لاکھ ڈالر سے کم ہو کر 1 ارب 1 کروڑ 91 لاکھ ڈالر پر آ گیا۔

مخصوص ممالک کے لحاظ سے دیکھا جائے تو مارچ سے جون کے دوران متحدہ عرب امارات کے لیے پاکستانی برآمدات میں سب سے زیادہ 42.7 فیصد کمی ہوئی۔ اسی طرح اسی عرصے میں سعودی عرب کو کی جانے والی برآمدات میں 1.7 فیصد اور عمان کو ہونے والی برآمدات میں 25.1 فیصد کی کمی ریکارڈ کی گئی۔

stories.title: China Pledges Strong Support for Cuba Against US Pressure
stories.summary:
Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi held talks in Beijing with his Cuban counterpart, Bruno Rodriguez Parrilla, where he pledged unwavering support for Cuba against sanctions, blockades, and foreign interference. Rodriguez was visiting China as a special envoy of Cuba's party and government, accompanied by Cuban Deputy Prime Minister Oscar Perez-Oliva Fraga. Wang stated that Beijing would firmly back Havana in safeguarding its national sovereignty and legitimate rights, regardless of changing global circumstances.

During the meeting, Wang praised Cuba for maintaining its independence, resisting pressure from powerful nations, and pursuing a socialist development path tailored to its national conditions. He also advocated for closer coordination between China and Cuba to counter unilateral actions and promote solidarity among Global South countries. In response, Rodriguez thanked Beijing for its development support and opposition to external interference.

The Cuban minister reaffirmed Havana's adherence to the one-China principle and its opposition to foreign interference in Beijing's internal affairs. Rodriguez also endorsed President Xi Jinping's vision of building a community with a shared future for humanity along with his four global initiatives. Both officials agreed to deepen bilateral cooperation and enhance coordination on regional and international issues.

stories.title: Woman Accused of Spying on Nvidia Boss Entered Taiwan on Hong Kong Passport
stories.summary:
Taiwan's immigration agency confirmed that a woman accused of spying for China while allegedly having an affair with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang traveled into the territory using a Hong Kong passport. National Immigration Agency Director-General Lin Horng-en stated that authorities possessed all entry and exit records for the individual, identified in reports as Alice Huang, a former Chinese executive at Singapore-based Megaspeed whom US officials suspect worked for Chinese intelligence. Beijing has denied these spying allegations, while Nvidia announced that its board initiated an investigation into Jensen Huang, who is unrelated to Alice Huang.

Taiwanese Interior Minister Liu Shyh-fang reported that the woman did enter the country but is currently located overseas. Liu noted that had authorities known she was a spy, entry would have been denied, and announced that the government plans to review screening procedures, spot checks, interviews, and post-visit protocols. Furthermore, Liu mentioned that her permit has been revoked, permanently preventing her return, while national security units actively pursue an investigation.

The situation drew heightened public attention following appearances at a May 2025 dinner in Taipei during the Computex tech expo. Journalists captured footage of Jensen Huang hosting the event at a Chinese restaurant, where he and the woman, wearing a pink dress, mingled with attendees. Video streams show the Nvidia CEO placing his arm around her while she kisses his right cheek.

The unfolding scandal matters as it places a major artificial intelligence titan at the center of international security and corporate governance scrutiny. Investigations into executive conduct and foreign intelligence operations have directly impacted Nvidia's market standing, reflecting growing geopolitical tensions surrounding technology leaders and cross-border access between China and Taiwan.

stories.title: کولکتا سے ممبئی جانے والی ایئر انڈیا کی پرواز میں ہائی جیکنگ کی دھمکی
stories.summary:
بھارت میں کولکتا سے ممبئی کی طرف جانے والی ایئر انڈیا کی ایک پرواز کو ہائی جیک کرنے کی دھمکی موصول ہونے کے بعد تمام مسافروں کو طیارے سے بحفاظت نیچے اتار لیا گیا ہے۔ بھارتی میڈیا کے مطابق یہ واقعہ اس وقت پیش آیا جب مسافر طیارہ ممبئی کے لیے روانہ ہونے کی تیاری کر رہا تھا۔

پرواز کے دوران طیارے کے واش روم سے ہاتھ سے لکھا ہوا ایک پراسرار اور دھمکی آمیز نوٹ برآمد ہوا جس میں طیارے کو ہائی جیک کرنے کی دھمکی درج تھی۔ نوٹ ملنے پر پائلٹ نے بغیر کسی تاخیر کے فوری طور پر ایئر ٹریفک کنٹرول کو اس صورتحال سے آگاہ کیا۔

اطلاع ملنے کے بعد ایئرپورٹ حکام نے فوری طور پر ہنگامی حفاظتی اقدامات نافذ کیے اور طیارے کو رن وے پر ایک محفوظ اور الگ تھلگ مقام پر منتقل کر دیا۔ حکام نے تمام مسافروں کو باحفاظت طیارے سے باہر نکال لیا۔

سکیورٹی فورسز اور اہلکاروں نے کسی بھی ممکنہ خطرے کا جائزہ لینے کے لیے طیارے کی مکمل تلاشی کا عمل شروع کر دیا ہے۔ تاہم اس خبر کے وقت تک دھمکی دینے والے نامعلوم شخص کی شناخت، نوٹ کے اصل پس منظر اور تلاشی کے حتمی نتائج سے متعلق مزید تفصیلات فراہم نہیں کی گئی ہیں۔

stories.title: Spanish Workers Launch First General Strike in 14 Years Over Housing
stories.summary:
Workers across Spain staged a 24-hour nationwide general strike on Wednesday to protest against a severe housing affordability crisis, marking the first joint general strike by the country's two largest unions, UGT and CCOO, in 14 years. The protests, which also involved tenants' associations and other labor organizations, coincided with anger over rising rents and evictions less than three weeks before a snap general election called by Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez. Participation was uneven, with strong support reported in coastal regions such as Catalonia, Andalusia, and the Cantabrian coast, where housing pressures are particularly acute.

Unions reported high participation rates in sectors like automotive manufacturing, ports, and energy, while transportation and industrial activities experienced widespread disruptions. Early demonstrations saw clashes, including an incident at Madrid's Mercamadrid wholesale market where police used pepper spray and arrested a demonstrator after around 1,000 protesters gathered. The housing crisis is fueled by a national home deficit projected to exceed one million by 2028, pushing average rents to 1,176 euros, which equals roughly 98.7 percent of a young person's average monthly salary. Business lobbies argued the strike was counterproductive and advocated for building more homes and lowering construction taxes, while afternoon protest marches faced additional threats from storms Charles and Bruna.

stories.title: Sindh Completes Over One Million Climate-Resilient Homes for 2022 Flood Victims
stories.summary:
The Sindh provincial government announced a major milestone in post-disaster recovery, confirming the completion of 1,007,111 climate-resilient houses for families affected by the catastrophic 2022 floods. Officials marked the achievement during a ceremony at the Chief Minister's House in Karachi, attended by Pakistan Peoples Party Chairman Bilawal Bhutto Zardari, Sindh Chief Minister Syed Murad Ali Shah, Chief Secretary Asif Hyder Shah, international development partners, and beneficiary families. The initiative is recognized as part of the world's largest housing reconstruction effort.

Chief Minister Murad Ali Shah dedicated the achievement to the residents of the province, noting that the project aimed to build 2.1 million climate-resilient homes for over 15 million people across 23 districts. Rather than relying on traditional contractors, the government implemented a community-driven reconstruction model that provided direct financial assistance to families, granting them ownership and control over construction. Digital monitoring, geo-tagging, and independent verification mechanisms were established at various construction stages to ensure transparency and accountability.

A central feature of the housing initiative involved registering properties in women's names to grant rural women property ownership, financial security, and independence. The project's funding combines nearly $1 billion in investments, including $500 million committed by the World Bank, $179 million from the Sindh government, alongside contributions from the Asian Development Bank, Islamic Development Bank, and European Investment Bank. Future phases of the program intend to deliver clean drinking water, sanitation, and drainage infrastructure to approximately 4,800 villages.

This development holds profound importance for millions of rural citizens who spent years dealing with inadequate shelter following the 2022 disaster. Beneficiary families expressed relief over receiving permanent, safer homes for their children, while international partners praised the initiative's institutional coordination and transparent framework in addressing large-scale climate vulnerabilities.

stories.title: ثانیہ مرزا نے شعیب ملک سے علیحدگی کے بعد نجی زندگی پر خاموشی توڑ دی
stories.summary:
معروف بھارتی ٹینس اسٹار ثانیہ مرزا نے سابق پاکستانی کرکٹر شعیب ملک سے طلاق اور علیحدگی کے بعد اپنی نجی زندگی سے متعلق جاری قیاس آرائیوں پر کھل کر بات کی ہے۔ انہوں نے واضح کیا ہے کہ اس وقت ان کی زندگی میں کوئی بھی نیا مرد موجود نہیں ہے۔

غیر ملکی میڈیا رپورٹس کے مطابق ثانیہ مرزا نے حال ہی میں اپنی قریبی دوست اور معروف فلمساز فرح خان کے ہمراہ نیہا دھوپیا اور انگد بیدی کے شو ’ڈبل ڈیٹ‘ میں شرکت کی۔ شو کے دوران میزبانوں نے ان کی ڈیٹنگ لائف اور کسی نئے رشتے کے بارے میں سوالات کیے۔

سوال کا جواب دیتے ہوئے ثانیہ نے دلچسپ انکشاف کیا کہ ان کے کئی مرد دوست انہیں باہر جانے کی دعوت ضرور دیتے ہیں مگر وہ انہیں صرف دوست کی نظر سے ہی دیکھتے ہیں۔ اس موقع پر ان کی دوست فرح خان نے بھی بتایا کہ اکثر لوگ ان سے پوچھتے ہیں کہ آیا ثانیہ واقعی سنگل ہیں۔

ثانیہ مرزا اور شعیب ملک کی شادی سال 2010 میں عمل میں آئی تھی اور ان کا ایک بیٹا بھی ہے جس کا نام اذہان مرزا ملک ہے۔ دونوں کے درمیان سال 2023 میں علیحدگی ہو گئی تھی، جس کے بعد شعیب ملک نے جنوری 2024 میں پاکستانی اداکارہ ثنا جاوید کے ساتھ دوسری شادی کر لی تھی۔

stories.title: Jamie Dornan Cried After Landing Aragorn Role in New Lord of the Rings Film
stories.summary:
Actor Jamie Dornan revealed that he was moved to tears when he discovered he had been cast as Aragorn in the upcoming film The Lord of the Rings: The Hunt for Gollum. Known for his roles in Belfast and The Fall, Dornan described the opportunity as a dream and an enormous honor, particularly because the character was memorably portrayed by Viggo Mortensen in Peter Jackson's original trilogy. Dornan noted that while he felt the pressure of following Mortensen, whom he considers one of his favorite performers, he is not trying to surpass the original portrayal but rather bring some of that original energy to the new project.

Dornan shared that he has already completed filming for the movie, finishing roughly three weeks prior to his interview. He expressed hope that audiences would warmly welcome the new story into the established fantasy franchise. Andy Serkis, who originally voiced and performed motion capture for Gollum, is directing the upcoming feature.

The film's cast features returning actors including Ian McKellen as Gandalf, Elijah Wood as Frodo, and Lee Pace as King Thranduil, alongside franchise newcomers Kate Winslet as Marigol, Leo Woodall as Halvard, and Anya Taylor-Joy as an elf. The Hunt for Gollum is scheduled for theatrical release on December 17, 2027.

stories.title: Pakistani Boxer Mohammad Waseem Stymied by Persistent Visa Hurdles
stories.summary:
Pakistani professional boxer Mohammad Waseem says ongoing visa complications are severely hindering his athletic career and preventing him from pursuing major global bouts. The two-time World Boxing Association gold champion and former three-time World Boxing Council silver flyweight titleholder revealed that he submitted his passport to the Spanish Embassy in July and remains stranded while awaiting clearance. Waseem noted that significant portions of his career are wasted attempting to secure travel permits, contrasting his current difficulties with a hypothetical scenario where living elsewhere might have yielded multiple world titles. Over the preceding year, his two WBA gold bouts took place domestically in Quetta and Lahore, while previous opportunities evaporated due to administrative roadblocks regarding travel to Dubai and Central Asia.

The Quetta native, who has previously completed training camps in Las Vegas, Florida, and Mexico, turned professional in 2015 after a distinguished amateur background. During his amateur tenure spanning over a decade, Waseem collected international accolades including a silver medal at the 2014 Commonwealth Games in Glasgow and a bronze medal at the Asian Games in Incheon during the same year. No other Pakistani boxer has earned an Asian Games medal since his achievement in Incheon. Waseem expressed frustration that his status as a successful professional fighter has not brought him adequate recognition or state backing within Pakistan, pointing out that government assistance with travel documents could have enabled him to populate the nation's trophy cabinet.

His attempts to secure a diplomatic passport from federal authorities during the Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf regime and under the current administration have yielded no responses. Waseem characterized the anticipated four-month processing period for a Spanish visa as a major setback that leaves him out of touch and unable to prioritize proper preparation. Throughout his professional journey, Waseem has recorded only two defeats, both against former world champions: Moruti Mthalane in Kuala Lumpur and Sunny Edwards in Dubai in March 2022.

Once his travel authorization arrives, Waseem plans to travel immediately to the United Kingdom to resume training in Liverpool under longtime coach Danny Vaughan. His promotional team is actively attempting to arrange a world title opportunity, while Waseem also intends to collaborate with Europe-based promoters to set up a preliminary ranking bout. The athlete renewed his plea for the federal government to intervene and supply him with a passport capable of bypassing unnecessary administrative delays for upcoming international assignments.

stories.title: راولپنڈی: اینکر ربیعہ احسن قتل کیس میں شوہر کا پولی گراف ٹیسٹ
stories.summary:
راولپنڈی سے تعلق رکھنے والی اینکر ربیعہ احسن کے مبینہ قتل کیس کی تفتیش کے سلسلے میں پولیس ملزم احسن کو پولی گراف ٹیسٹ کے لیے لاہور لے کر روانہ ہو گئی ہے۔ تفتیشی ذرائع کے مطابق جائے وقوع اور پوسٹ مارٹم سے حاصل کردہ سیمپلز کا تجزیہ کرایا جائے گا جبکہ ملزم کا ڈی این اے ٹیسٹ بھی کیا جائے گا۔ پولیس کو اس پولی گراف ٹیسٹ کی رپورٹ ہفتے کو ملنے کا امکان ہے۔

مزید تفتیش کے لیے ربیعہ احسن کے تینوں موبائل فونز کا فرانزک بھی کرایا جا رہا ہے جن پر کوئی پاس ورڈ یا سیکیورٹی کوڈ نہیں تھا۔ تفتیشی ذرائع نے بتایا ہے کہ مقتولہ اور ان کے شوہر کے درمیان چیٹ کا ریکارڈ بھی حاصل کر لیا گیا ہے اور ابتدائی تجزیے میں کسی بھی تنازع یا دشمنی کے شواہد سامنے نہیں آئے ہیں۔

موبাইল فونز کی یہ فرانزک رپورٹ بعد میں کیس کے چالان کا حصہ بنائی جائے گی۔ پولیس اس کیس کے ہر پہلو کا باریک بینی سے جائزہ لے رہی ہے تاکہ حقیقت تک پہنچا جا سکے اور عدم شواہد یا دیگر قانونی تقاضوں کو پورا کیا جا سکے جب کہ متعلقہ اداروں کی طرف سے مزید کارروائی جاری ہے۔

stories.title: کوٹ ادو میں پسند کی شادی کی اجازت نہ ملنے پر نوجوان کی خودسوزی
stories.summary:
کوٹ ادو کے علاقے تونسہ موڑ پر ایک نوجوان نے پسند کی شادی کی اجازت نہ ملنے پر اپنی زندگی کے خاتمے کی کوشش کی۔ دلبرداشتہ ہو کر اس نوجوان نے خود پر ڈیزل چھڑک کر آگ لگا لی جس کے نتیجے میں وہ شدید جھلس گیا۔

ریسکیو حکام کے مطابق اس حادثے یا اقدام میں نوجوان کے جسم کا 60 فیصد سے زائد حصہ متاثر ہوا ہے۔ واقعے کی اطلاع ملتے ہی اسے فوری طور پر طبی امداد کے لیے ہسپتال منتقل کیا گیا۔

حالت زیادہ تشویشناک ہونے کی وجہ سے اس نوجوان کو ملتان کے نشتر اسپتال کے برن یونٹ میں منتقل کر دیا گیا ہے۔ اہل خانہ کے مطابق نوجوان نے یہ انتہائی قدم گھریلو ناچاقی اور پسند کی شادی کی اجازت نہ ملنے سے دلبرداشتہ ہو کر اٹھایا۔

stories.title: UNICEF Announces International Career Openings for Qualified Pakistani Professionals
stories.summary:
The Bureau of Emigration and Overseas Employment in Islamabad has announced international employment opportunities with the United Nations Children's Fund, encouraging qualified Pakistani professionals to apply. The initiative points to UNICEF's global presence spanning more than 190 countries and territories, supported by a workforce exceeding 15,000 professionals dedicated to protecting children's rights and improving well-being internationally.

Available positions cover a wide range of professional fields, including programme management, education, child protection, health, nutrition, communications, information technology, finance, and administration. The vacancies span multiple experience tiers, from entry-level positions and internships to mid-career and senior management roles, offering professionals a chance to participate in international development, humanitarian assistance, and child welfare initiatives.

The recruitment campaign emphasizes UNICEF's core commitments to workplace diversity, equal opportunities, and creating an inclusive environment for candidates from varied backgrounds. Interested applicants are directed to review eligibility requirements and submit their applications through the organization's official career portal.

To safeguard applicants against widespread recruitment fraud targeting overseas job seekers, the agency issued a strict warning regarding fees. UNICEF explicitly reiterated that it never charges any money at any stage of the recruitment process, covering applications, processing, interviews, visas, or training.

stories.title: Imran Khan Alert and Strong Despite Frightening Blood Pressure, Says Lawyer
stories.summary:
PTI leader and lawyer Sardar Latif Khosa stated on Wednesday that party founder Imran Khan's blood pressure was at a frightening level, though the former prime minister remained completely alert and mentally strong during a lengthy meeting at Adiala Jail. Khosa, alongside Barrister Salman Safdar, met with Imran and Bushra Bibi for three to four hours. The visit was permitted following an Islamabad High Court (IHC) order issued on Tuesday, which directed authorities to facilitate a one-hour legal consultation regarding the £190 million case so that counsel could prepare arguments for upcoming appeals.

Speaking to the media after the consultation, Khosa noted that the discussions covered the health conditions and legal cases of both Imran and Bushra Bibi, and mentioned that a possible 28th constitutional amendment was also broached. He added that further details regarding what the lawyers observed and what instructions were given would be disclosed subsequently. Similarly, Barrister Salman Safdar posted on X that the lengthy session allowed for a detailed review of legal and medical matters, with comprehensive instructions provided by both clients. Prior to entering the facility, Safdar emphasized to reporters that the conversation would strictly focus on legal cases rather than general politics.

Access to Imran Khan and Bushra Bibi at Adiala Jail has faced severe restrictions, with regular weekly family and legal visits largely denied since December 2025. Although courts have intermittently intervened to order meetings, such as directives from the IHC in June and the Supreme Court in August, visits have remained infrequent and tightly controlled. Defense lawyers have previously reported that the couple has been kept in solitary confinement for nearly 24 hours a day without access to books, television, family, or legal counsel, making court-mandated sessions crucial for their ongoing legal proceedings.

stories.title: ڈی آئی خان میں کوچ اور موٹر سائیکل کے تصادم سے تین افراد جاں بحق
stories.summary:
ڈیرہ اسماعیل خان میں تبلیغی جماعت کے افراد کو لے جانے والی ایک مسافر کوچ اور موٹر سائیکل کے درمیان خوفناک ٹریفک حادثہ پیش آیا ہے۔ اس حادثے کے نتیجے میں موقع پر ہی تین افراد جاں بحق جبکہ خواتین اور بچوں سمیت تیرہ مسافر شدید زخمی ہو گئے۔

حادثے کی اطلاع ملتے ہی ریسکیو 1122 کی میڈیکل ٹیمیں فوری طور پر جائے وقوعہ پر پہنچ گئیں۔ امدادی ٹیموں نے موقع پر ہی تمام زخمیوں کو ابتدائی طبی امداد فراہم کی اور فوری طور پر انہیں مزید علاج کے لیے مفتی محمود اسپتال منتقل کر دیا، جبکہ جاں بحق ہونے والے تینوں افراد کی لاشیں بھی ضروری کارروائی کے لیے اسی اسپتال پہنچائی گئیں۔

حادثے میں متاثر ہونے والے افراد میں دو خواتین اور ایک معصوم بچہ بھی شامل ہیں۔ زخمی ہونے والے مسافروں کی شناخت ٹیکہ خان، سدیس، وحید گل، میر خان، ارسلہ خان، غلام یاسین، فتح محمد، یوسف، ناظم شاہ، مشرف، حیات شاہ، سراج اور گلفام کے ناموں سے کی گئی ہے۔

ریسکیو 1122 کی ٹیموں نے بروقت اور مؤثر کارروائی کا مظاہرہ کرتے ہوئے حادثے کے متاثرین کو فوری طبی امداد دی اور تمام زخمیوں کو بحفاظت اسپتال منتقل کرنے کا فریضہ سر انجام دیا۔

stories.title: Pakistan Stock Exchange Drops Over 500 Points Amid Regional Shipping Security Concerns
stories.summary:
Selling pressure emerged at the Pakistan Stock Exchange during morning trading, driven by anxieties regarding ongoing attacks on commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz. The benchmark KSE-100 Index dropped over 500 points during the opening minutes of the session, hovering at 178,812.16 points, representing a decline of 523.08 points or 0.29 percent. Market activity revealed widespread selling across key economic sectors, including automobile assemblers, cement producers, commercial banks, oil and gas exploration firms, and oil marketing companies.

Major index-heavy equities experienced downward movement, with stocks such as HUBCO, SSGC, MARI, PPL, MCB, MEBL, NBP, and UBL trading in negative territory. This downturn contrasts with the previous session, where the local bourse rallied by 5,448.56 points, or 3.13 percent, to close at 179,335.24 points following optimism surrounding peace remarks by US President Donald Trump. Regional and global financial markets faced additional pressures from shifting monetary policy expectations and corporate developments.

Internationally, bond markets softened and the US dollar remained strong following stronger-than-expected US inflation data for October, which recorded a monthly core rate of 0.3 percent. Federal Reserve officials signaled potential aggressive rate hikes, creating a cautious environment for global equities, though broader Asian and European stock futures displayed resilience. Meanwhile, technology giant Nvidia continued to experience market volatility, with shares sliding 5.5 percent overnight and bringing total losses from recent peaks to 30 percent as the company investigates its chief executive.

The stock market fluctuations matter as they directly impact investor confidence, capital flows, and macroeconomic stability in Pakistan. Persistent regional maritime disruptions combined with shifting global interest rate projections continue to introduce high volatility into domestic financial markets.

stories.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Faces Potential Record $77.6B Divorce Settlement
stories.summary:
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang recently confessed to an extramarital affair, leading to speculation that his wife, Lori Huang, might file for divorce. According to Forbes, Huang's net worth was estimated at $155.2 billion on November 9. Because the couple married in 1985—eight years before Nvidia was established in 1993—all of his stock holdings in the company were accumulated during their marriage. This makes him the company's largest single investor with a stake exceeding 3.5%.

California law recognizes community property, meaning assets obtained during a marriage belong equally to both partners and are typically split 50/50 in a divorce. This statutory rule suggests a potential settlement ranging between $75 billion and $77.5 billion, or roughly $77.6 billion. However, stock volatility could significantly alter this headline figure before any formal calculation occurs. At a minimum, such a payout would double MacKenzie Scott's approximate $36 billion Amazon stock settlement from her divorce from Jeff Bezos, making it the largest billionaire divorce settlement in history.

Despite the basic 50/50 community property framework, the final settlement could be lower. Nvidia's 2026 proxy statement lists Lori Huang as a co-trustee of family trusts holding over 528 million shares as of March 2026, and assets held in trust structures do not always divide equally. Furthermore, it remains unknown whether the couple signed a prenuptial or postnuptial agreement, and Huang could attempt to claim separate property. Since California operates as a no-fault state, Huang's infidelity will not impact the division of property.

Huang revealed his affair in a November 8 memo to Nvidia employees, admitting he was unfaithful to his wife and apologizing to his family and staff. Despite the personal fallout, Huang stated his intention to continue leading the company.

stories.title: Binance Warns iPhone Users of iOS Vulnerability Risking Crypto Credentials
stories.summary:
Cryptocurrency exchange Binance issued an alert to iPhone users regarding a newly discovered iOS security flaw that could allow malicious apps to access sensitive data stored by other applications. Known as “worse_query”, the vulnerability impacts Apple’s iOS versions 26.7.1, 27.0.1, and 27.2. According to Binance, the bug originates in the Apple operating system rather than its own application, potentially exposing local files such as cryptocurrency wallet recovery phrases, private keys, and account credentials.

Cybersecurity experts explained that the vulnerability allows unauthorized apps to bypass built-in security protections, enabling a sandbox escape where apps can read private information across application boundaries. Researchers created a proof-of-concept tool named WQ Files to show how files can be browsed, modified, or deleted without jailbreaking the device. However, exploiting the flaw requires tricking a user into installing malicious software from an unofficial distribution channel.

Apple released security updates on November 9, including iOS 27.2.1 and iOS 26.7.3, to fix multiple issues, though it remains unconfirmed if they directly resolve the “worse_query” flaw. Until more details emerge, Binance advises users to install the latest security updates, delete untrusted or unneeded applications, and strictly avoid downloading software from sources outside the Apple App Store.

For users who suspect their crypto assets were compromised, Binance recommends transferring digital holdings to a newly generated wallet on a trusted device and resetting active login sessions. These steps aim to prevent unauthorized access while the security community awaits further clarification from Apple regarding the vulnerability and its official patches.

stories.title: Profit-Taking Pulls Pakistan Stock Exchange Below 180,000 Points
stories.summary:
The Pakistan Stock Exchange (PSX) experienced a consolidation phase on Wednesday, falling below the 180,000-point threshold after profit-taking erased earlier intraday gains. The benchmark KSE-100 index opened positively, extending previous bullish momentum to reach an intraday high of 180,769 points, reflecting a 1,434-point or 0.80 percent increase—a level not witnessed since August 18. However, selling pressure near the 180,000 mark triggered a retreat, pulling the index down by over 250 points to close near 179,880 points by the end of the session, according to Ali Najib, Deputy Head of Trading at Arif Habib Ltd.

Sector-specific movements showed cement stocks extending gains amid market optimism ahead of the Federal Constitutional Court's expected verdict next week regarding the Punjab cement royalty case, which investors anticipate will yield a favorable outcome for manufacturers. Additionally, Thatta Cement informed the PSX that it finalized a definitive agreement with the Fauji Foundation for the restructuring of PSEL. Top positive contributors to the index included PSO, PSEL, EFERT, FABL, and SYS, which collectively added around 290 points. Conversely, profit-taking in heavyweights like UBL, MEBL, LUCK, NBP, and FCCL eroded 428 points from the benchmark index.

Market activity remained robust overall, with total trading volume hitting 1.24 billion shares and a traded value reaching Rs41.7 billion. Worldcall Telecom (WTL) led the volume chart with 231 million shares traded during the session. Looking ahead, market analysts suggest the exchange may retain a positive bias driven by strong investor sentiment and cement stocks, though intermittent volatility and selective buying are expected to remain the preferred strategy as traders navigate profit-taking near the 180,000 level.

stories.title: عدلیہ کی آزادی آئین اور قانون کے تابع ہونی چاہیے، جسٹس جمال مندوخیل
stories.summary:
سپریم کورٹ کے الوداعی ریفرنس سے خطاب کرتے ہوئے جسٹس جمال مندوخیل نے کہا کہ عدلیہ کو انتظامیہ سے الگ ہونا لازمی ہے تاکہ قانون کسی طاقتور کی خواہش کا غلام نہ بنے۔ انہوں نے اس بات پر زور دیا کہ آئین کے تحت حاصل اختیارات کسی کی ذاتی ملکیت نہیں بلکہ ایک امانت ہیں۔

جسٹس جمال مندوخیل کا مزید کہنا تھا کہ ایک جج اپنے حلف کے بغیر کچھ نہیں ہوتا اور عدلیہ کو آزاد ہونے کے ساتھ ساتھ آئین اور قانون کے ماتحت بھی رہنا چاہیے۔ انہوں نے واضح کیا کہ جج کے کردار اور دیانت داری کا اصل معیار اس کے عدالتی فیصلے ہوتے ہیں جبکہ عدالتیں سائلین کے لیے خوف کی جگہ نہیں ہونی چاہئیں۔

تقریب میں اٹارنی جنرل منصور عثمان اعوان نے بھی خطاب کیا اور جسٹس جمال مندوخیل کی قانونی خدمات کو سراہا۔ اٹارنی جنرل نے ان کی بطور چیف جسٹس بلوچستان ہائیکورٹ اور سپریم کورٹ کے جج کی حیثیت سے کارکردگی کو یادگار قرار دیا۔

stories.title: بھارتی کرکٹر رنکو سنگھ اور رکن پارلیمنٹ پریا سروج کی شادی کی تاریخ طے
stories.summary:
بھارتی کرکٹ ٹیم کے بلے باز رنکو سنگھ اور سماج وادی پارٹی کی رکن پارلیمنٹ پریا سروج کی شادی رواں سال 4 دسمبر کو لکھنؤ میں منعقد ہوگی۔ بھارتی میڈیا کے مطابق اس تقریب کی تیاریاں تیزی سے جاری ہیں اور شادی کے دعوت نامے بھی چھپ چکے ہیں۔

شادی کی یہ تقریب لکھنؤ کے رامادا ہوٹل اینڈ کنونشن سینٹر میں منعقد کی جائے گی۔ اس جوڑے کی منگنی گزشتہ سال جون میں ایک پروقار تقریب میں ہوئی تھی جس میں سیاسی شخصیات نے شرکت کی تھی۔ رنکو سنگھ خود بھی اس تقریب کی تیاریوں میں بڑھ چڑھ کر حصہ لے رہے ہیں۔

پریا سروج پیشے کے لحاظ سے ایک وکیل ہیں اور بھارت کی کم عمر ترین ارکان پارلیمنٹ میں شامل ہیں۔ رواں سال رنکو سنگھ کے والد کے انتقال کی وجہ سے یہ شادی ان کے خاندان کے لیے خصوصی جذباتی اہمیت کی حامل ہے۔

stories.title: OGDCL Makes Significant Gas and Condensate Discovery in Sindh's Khairpur
stories.summary:
Oil & Gas Development Company Ltd (OGDCL) announced a new hydrocarbon discovery at its Bitrisim Northwest-1 exploratory well located in the Khairpur district of Sindh. The company officially disclosed the find in a filing submitted to the Pakistan Stock Exchange on Wednesday. OGDCL operates the Bitrisim Exploration License with a 95% working interest, while Government Holdings (Private) Limited holds the remaining 5% share.

During testing operations, the exploratory well produced 12.8 million standard cubic feet per day of gas alongside 175 barrels of condensate daily. The flow was achieved using a 32/64-inch choke at a wellhead flowing pressure of 3,020 pounds per square inch. The well was spudded on August 21, 2026, reaching a total depth of 3,732 meters into the Sembar Formation before a Drill Stem Test was conducted in the Basal Sands of the Lower Goru Formation based on well log interpretations.

The company is currently fast-tracking activities to integrate the new well into the national gas gathering system for early commercial exploitation. OGDCL stated that the discovery expands its hydrocarbon reserve base and bolsters national energy security by utilizing indigenous resources to help bridge the widening demand-supply gap.

As Pakistan's largest exploration and production firm, OGDCL manages extensive operations spanning drilling, production, reservoir management, and engineering support, covering over 40% of the country's awarded exploration acreage. The Government of Pakistan remains the majority shareholder with over a 67% stake, alongside the OGDC Employee Empowerment Trust and the Privatisation Commission.

stories.title: Bangladesh Prosecutor States Sheikh Hasina Must Face Court Verdict Upon Return
stories.summary:
Bangladesh’s International Crimes Tribunal Chief Prosecutor, Mohammad Aminul Islam, stated that former Prime Minister and Awami League chief Sheikh Hasina will face a death sentence verdict if she returns to the country. Speaking on Tuesday, November 10, 2026, Islam criticized Hasina for remaining abroad instead of appearing before the tribunal during her trial proceedings to present a proper legal defense.

Reports previously indicated that Hasina planned to return to Bangladesh in December despite potential risks of arrest or assassination, asserting that fear of imprisonment would not deter her duties to the public. Meanwhile, legal representatives in London reportedly approached the Bangladesh High Commission in New Delhi to secure a new passport and national identity card for her.

Chief Prosecutor Islam dismissed any possibility of issuing travel documents to an individual facing a death sentence, citing specific provisions within the Bangladesh Passport Order 1973. He highlighted sections six and seven, which legally restrict passport issuance to individuals convicted of offenses involving moral turpitude carrying prison sentences of at least two years.

Islam reiterated that Hasina was required to return during the trial phase and would have had 30 days following the verdict to file a formal legal appeal. With her current legal status and convictions standing, authorities maintain that her return leaves no alternative to facing the mandated judicial penalties.

stories.title: پاکستانی اداکارہ میرا کی والدہ چھوٹی بیٹی کی کینسر سے جنگ پر آبدیدہ
stories.summary:
پاکستانی اداکارہ میرا کی والدہ نے اپنی چھوٹی بیٹی شائستہ کی کینسر کے باعث ہونے والی موت اور اس دوران جھیلی گئی تکلیفوں کا ذکر کرتے ہوئے آنسو بہائے۔ سوشل میڈیا پر سامنے آنے والی ایک ویڈیو میں انہوں نے بتایا کہ شائستہ نے اس خطرناک بیماری کا انتہائی بہادری سے مقابلہ کیا۔

انہوں نے انکشاف کیا کہ بیماری کی وجہ سے شائستہ کا بایاں بازو کام کرنا چھوڑ گیا تھا اور تین ماہ قبل شدید خون بہنے کی وجہ سے انہیں ہنگامی حالت میں اسپتال منتقل کیا گیا جہاں وہ جانبر نہ ہو سکیں۔ میرا اپنی بہن سے بے پناہ محبت کرتی تھیں اور لندن میں ان کی پڑھائی کے تمام اخراجات خود اٹھاتی تھیں۔

والدہ نے بتایا کہ بہن کی وفات کی خبر نے اداکارہ میرا کو شدید صدمے سے دوچار کر دیا ہے۔ میرا کی خواہش تھی کہ شائستہ کو علاج کے لیے پاکستان لایا جائے مگر طبی حالت خراب ہونے کے باعث ڈاکٹروں نے سفر کرنے کی اجازت نہیں دی تھی۔

stories.title: US House Blocks Impeachment Push Against Polarizing Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth
stories.summary:
Republicans in the US House of Representatives successfully blocked an effort to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, voting 211 to 204 to refer eight articles of impeachment to the House Judiciary Committee. Sponsored by outgoing Republican Representative Thomas Massie of Kentucky, the procedural move effectively killed the current impeachment effort, which accused Hegseth of high crimes and misdemeanors related to military actions in Iran, Yemen, the Caribbean, and Venezuela. No other Republicans joined Massie, while 11 Democrats missed the vote.

President Donald Trump celebrated the vote as a total failure of the impeachment push and an exoneration of Hegseth. The defense secretary had earlier delivered a defiant defense of his leadership at the Pentagon, calling the Iran conflict lawful and arguing that his military directives left Iran's military in ruins. Although Democrats and many voters expressed anger over the unauthorized Iran conflict, party leaders noted they may revisit impeachment efforts in the next Congress after winning control in recent midterm elections.

If Democrats revive the impeachment push when they take office in January, the proceedings could intensify by calling fired military generals and admirals to testify. Lawmakers might also examine other controversial Pentagon policies, including military aid to Ukraine and strikes on suspected drug trafficking boats. Critics argue that Hegseth's strained relations with Congress pose a political liability as the administration seeks a massive budget increase to $1.5 trillion.

Despite political friction, Vice President JD Vance and other administration allies backed Hegseth, emphasizing that the conflict with lawmakers stems from his efforts to dismantle entrenched Pentagon bureaucracy. Hegseth himself continues to champion major reforms to reshape what he previously described as a weak and ideologically compromised military establishment.

stories.title: سندھ حکومت کا ربیع سیزن کیلئے آبادگاروں کو 17 ارب روپے سبسڈی دینے کا اعلان
stories.summary:
سندھ حکومت نے ربیع سیزن کے دوران سندھ ویٹ گروورز سپورٹ پروگرام کے تحت آبادگاروں میں 17 ارب روپے کی سبسڈی تقسیم کرنے کا فیصلہ کیا ہے۔ اس سلسلے میں پاکستان پیپلز پارٹی کے چیئرمین بلاول بھٹو زرداری 20 نومبر کو وزیراعلیٰ ہاؤس میں سبسڈی کی رقم کی فراہمی کا باقاعدہ افتتاح کریں گے۔

اس حوالے سے وزیر زراعت سندھ سردار محمد بخش خان مہر کی زیر صدارت ایک اہم اجلاس منعقد ہوا جس میں تقریب کی تیاریوں اور کسانوں کی رجسٹریشن پر بریفنگ دی گئی۔ سیکریٹری زراعت محمد زمان ناریجو نے اجلاس کو انتظامات کے بارے میں تفصیلی طور پر آگاہ کیا۔

مقررہ تقریب میں وزیراعلیٰ سندھ، صوبائی وزراء، اراکین سندھ اسمبلی اور پارٹی رہنما شرکت کریں گے۔ رواں ربیع سیزن میں بینظیر ہاری کارڈ کے توسط سے تقریبا ساڑھے پانچ لاکھ آبادگار اس سبسڈی پروگرام سے مستفید ہوں گے۔

stories.title: مسلم لیگ ن میں مریم نواز کے خلاف دھڑا بن رہا ہے، غلام مصطفیٰ ملک
stories.summary:
پاکستان مسلم لیگ ق کے ترجمان غلام مصطفیٰ ملک نے ایک نجی ٹی وی انٹرویو میں دعویٰ کیا ہے کہ حکمگزار جماعت مسلم لیگ ن کے اندر وزیراعلیٰ پنجاب مریم نواز کے خلاف ایک الگ گروپ تشکیل پا رہا ہے۔ ان کا کہنا تھا کہ اچھے اقدامات کی توثیق کا ہرگز یہ مطلب نہیں کہ حکومت کی ہر پالیسی کو درست مان لیا جائے۔ انہوں نے مؤقف اختیار کیا کہ سال 2023 میں پنجاب کی وزارتِ اعلیٰ ق لیگ کو دینے کا معاہدہ طے پایا تھا جس پر عملدرآمد نہیں کیا گیا، اور اگر طے شدہ معاہدے پر عمل ہوتا تو آج مریم نواز اس منصب پر فائز نہ ہوتیں۔

غلام مصطفیٰ ملک نے مزید انکشاف کیا کہ ان کی جماعت کے تعاون کے بغیر شہباز شریف ملک کے وزیراعظم نہیں بن سکتے تھے کیونکہ ق لیگ نے ہی انہیں وزارتِ عظمیٰ کے لیے اپنا ووٹ دیا تھا۔ انہوں نے صوبے کے سرکاری محکموں، تھانوں، کچہریوں، پٹواریوں اور تحصیل داروں کے نظام پر بات کرتے ہوئے کہا کہ کرپشن کی وجہ سے عام شہریوں کو معمولی اور جائز کام کے حصول کے لیے بھی لازਮੀ طور پر رشوت دینا پڑتی ہے اور سرکاری اداروں میں عام آدمی کا برا حال ہے۔

ترجمان نے وضاحت کی کہ جب چوہدری سالک حسین نے ایک عمومی نوعیت کے عوامی مسئلے کی نشاندہی کرتے ہوئے بدعنوانی کا الزام عائد کیا تھا، تو وزیراعلیٰ مریم نواز نے اسے ذاتی نوعیت کا مسئلہ سمجھ لیا۔ ان کا ماننا ہے کہ کوئی بھی حکومت یہ دعویٰ نہیں کر سکتی کہ اس کے دور حکومت میں بدعنوانی مکمل طور پر ختم ہو چکی ہے کیونکہ یہ ایک بہت بڑا چیلنج ہے جس کے تدارک کے لیے سنجیدہ اور عملی اقدامات کرنے کی ضرورت ہے۔

انہوں نے گفتگو کے آخر میں اس بات پر زور دیا کہ ان کی پارٹی کی اولین ترجیح عام شہریوں کے مسائل کا حل ہے۔ بڑے ترقیاتی منصوبوں میں بدعنوانی اور شفافیت کے معاملات اپنی جگہ اہم ہیں، لیکن اصل مسئلہ یہ ہے کہ عام شہریوں کو تھانے، کچہری اور دیگر سرکاری دفاتر میں شدید مشکلات کا سامنا کرنا پڑتا ہے جہاں پیسے دیے بغیر کسی کی فریاد نہیں سنی جاتی۔

stories.title: وزیراعظم شہباز شریف کی ترکیہ میں کوپ 31 سربراہی اجلاس میں شرکت
stories.summary:
وزیراعظم محمد شہباز شریف نے اپنے دورہ ترکیہ کے دوران کوپ 31 (COP31) ماحولیاتی سربراہی اجلاس میں شرکت کی۔ وزیراعظم کی کانفرنس ہال آمد پر ترکیہ کے صدر رجب طیب ایردوان اور اقوام متحدہ کے سیکرٹری جنرل انتونیو گوتریس نے ان کا انتہائی پرتپاک استقبال کیا۔ اس عالمی ماحولیاتی کانفرنس کا انعقاد ترکیہ میں کیا گیا ہے جہاں دنیا بھر کے نمایاں رہنما جمع ہوئے ہیں۔

وزیراعظم آفس کے میڈیا ونگ کی جانب سے جاری کردہ تفصیلی بیان کے مطابق، وزیراعظم محمد شہباز شریف بدھ کے روز اس اہم ماحولیاتی کانفرنس کے ہال میں پہنچے۔ ترکیہ کے صدر رجب طیب ایردوان اور اقوام متحدہ کے سیکرٹری جنرل انتونیو گوتریس نے ذاتی طور پر آگے بڑھ کر ان کا استقبال کیا، جو عالمی سطح پر پاکستان کی سفارتی اہمیت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔

کانفرنس کے دوران وزیراعظم محمد شہباز شریف نے دیگر شریک عالمی رہنماؤں کے ساتھ گروپ فوٹو میں بھی شرکت کی۔ اس موقع پر انہوں نے مختلف ممالک کے سربراہان سے ملاقاتیں کیں، ان سے پرخلوص مصافحہ کیا اور باہمی خیرسگالی کے جذبے کے تحت مختلف پیغامات کا تبادلہ کیا۔

اس عالمی سربراہی اجلاس میں شرکت کا مقصد ماحولیاتی تبدیلیوں جیسے اہم اور حساس عالمی چیلنجز سے نمٹنے کے لیے مشترکہ لائحہ عمل طے کرنا اور بین الاقوامی تعاون کو فروغ دینا ہے۔ اس دورے کے دوران وزیراعظم کی عالمی رہنماؤں سے ملاقاتیں اور باہمی رابطے خطے اور دنیا بھر میں ماحولیاتی اور سیاسی امور کے تناظر میں خاصی اہمیت کے حامل ہیں۔

stories.title: کسانوں کو گندم کی مقررہ امدادی قیمت دینا ہر صورت یقینی بنائیں گے، رانا تنویر حسین
stories.summary:
وفاقی وزیر برائے قومی غذائی تحفظ و تحقیق رانا تنویر حسین نے اعلان کیا ہے کہ حکومت کی جانب سے گندم کی امدادی قیمت چار ہزار پانچ سو روپے فی من مقرر کی گئی ہے، اور کسانوں کو یہ مقرر کردہ امدادی قیمت ہر صورت فراہم کی جائے گی۔ انہوں نے اس بات کا عزم ظاہر کیا کہ اس قیمت کے حصول میں کسانوں کو کسی قسم کی مشکل پیش نہیں آنے دی جائے گی اور حکومت اس کی مکمل ضمانت فراہم کرتی ہے۔

رانا تنویر حسین نے ملک کے تمام کسانوں پر زور دیا کہ وہ فی ایکڑ زرعی پیداوار میں خاطر خواہ اضافہ کرنے کے لیے زمین میں کھادوں کا متوازن استعمال لازمی بنائیں۔ انہوں نے خبردار کیا کہ کھادوں کا غیر متوازن استعمال نہ صرف زرعی پیداوار کو بری طرح متاثر کرتا ہے بلکہ اس سے زمین کی قدرتی زرخیزی بھی کم ہوتی ہے، جبکہ مٹی کا سائنسی تجزیہ کروا کر کھادوں کا استعمال پیداوار بڑھانے کا بہترین اور مؤثر ذریعہ ہے۔

وفاقی وزیر نے مزید کہا کہ گندم کی فصل کی بہتر اور وافر پیداوار حاصل کرنے کے لیے معیاری بیج، متوازن کھاد اور جدید زرعی طریقوں کا اپنانا انتہائی ضروری ہے۔ انہوں نے کسانوں کو مشورہ دیا کہ وہ زرعی ماہرین کی جانب سے دی گئی سفارشات کے مطابق کھادوں کا بروقت استعمال کریں تاکہ فصل کو نقصان سے بچایا جا سکے اور بہتر منافع کمایا جا سکے۔

ان کا مزید کہنا تھا کہ فی ایکڑ پیداوار میں اضافہ براہ راست کسانوں کی مالی خوشحالی اور ملکی غذائی تحفظ کے لیے ناگزیر حیثیت رکھتا ہے۔ حکومت کسانوں کے معاشی تحفظ اور مجموعی زرعی شعبے کے استحکام کے لیے عملی اقدامات کر رہی ہے، اور گندم کی پیداوار میں اضافے کے مقاصد کو حاصل کرنے کے لیے حکومت اور کسانوں کو مل کر مشترکہ کوششیں کرنا ہوں گی۔

stories.title: PTI Founder Imran Khan Briefly Hospitalized for Medical Checks
stories.summary:
Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI) founder Imran Khan was temporarily transferred from Adiala Jail to the Pakistan Institute of Medical Sciences (PIMS) for a medical evaluation late Wednesday night. According to sources, a dedicated team of doctors performed a health assessment that lasted approximately 90 minutes, which included checking his blood pressure and temperature along with necessary eye examinations. Following the evaluation, he was moved back to Adiala Jail.

This is not the first instance of Khan being taken to a hospital for medical reasons. In August, following court orders, he was transferred to a private hospital. A three-member bench had previously directed his stay at Shifa International Hospital, permitting his personal physician, Dr Faisal Sultan, and sister, Dr Uzma Khan, to remain with him, alongside weekly family visits. The court had adjourned the hearing until September 16, addressing concerns raised by his legal team and family regarding his health and access to medical facilities.

During those court proceedings, discussions also focused on the confidentiality of medical reports and treatment expenses. Counsel for Imran Khan assured the judiciary that his family would cover all costs associated with his medical care. Furthermore, Barrister Salman Akram Raja guaranteed the court that the generated medical reports would not be exploited for any political objectives.

These ongoing medical transfers matter as they consistently highlight the intense legal and public scrutiny surrounding the health, detention conditions, and welfare of the imprisoned political leader. The involvement of higher courts underlines the persistent tension between the state's detention authorities and Khan's legal representatives, keeping his medical status a focal point of national interest.

stories.title: راولپنڈی: اینکر پرسن ربیعہ احسن کی موت پر شوہر کے ریمانڈ میں توسیع
stories.summary:
پاکستان کے شہر راولپنڈی میں پولیس نے اینکر پرسن ربیعہ احسن کی موت کے معاملے میں ان کے شوہر کے جسمانی ریمانڈ میں مزید چار روز کی توسیع حاصل کر لی ہے۔ تفتیشی ٹیم اب ملزم کو پولی گرافک ٹیسٹ کے لیے لاہور لے کر جائے گی تاکہ ان کے پولیس کو دیے گئے بیان کی تصدیق یا تضاد کا جائزہ لیا جا سکے۔ یہ واقعہ آٹھ نومبر کو راولپنڈی کے علاقے گلشن آباد میں پیش آیا تھا جہاں 41 سالہ ربیعہ احسن کی لاش ان کے گھر کے ایک کمرے سے برآمد ہوئی تھی اور ان کی گردن کے نچلے حصے پر گولی کا نشان پایا گیا تھا۔ پولیس نے جائے وقوعہ سے ایک تیس بور کا غیر لائسنس یافتہ پستول بھی برآمد کیا تھا۔ 

ابتدائی تفتیش کے دوران ملزم نے مؤقف اختیار کیا تھا کہ الماری سے کپڑے نکالتے وقت ہاتھ میں پکڑا ہوا پستول حادثاتی طور پر چل گیا تھا۔ اس مقدمے کا مقدمہ مقتولہ کے بھائی خرم احمد کی مدعیت میں تھانہ صدر بیرونی میں درج کیا گیا تھا۔ تاہم مقتولہ کے اہلِ خانہ نے اس مقدمے کو واپس لینے کا فیصلہ کیا ہے کیونکہ ان کا ماننا ہے کہ یہ ایک حادثہ تھا اور میاں بیوی کے درمیان کوئی تنازع نہیں تھا۔ 

واقعے کے بعد سے سیاسی شخصیات اور صحافیوں کی جانب سے اس موت پر گہرے دکھ اور صدمے کا اظہار کیا گیا ہے۔ ربیعہ احسن نجی ٹی وی چینل چینل 92 سے وابستہ تھیں اور پروگرام 'مقابل' کی میزبانی کرتی تھیں۔ وہ دو بیٹیوں کی ماں تھیں۔ 

پولیس حکام کا کہنا ہے کہ فرانزک شواہد اور پوسٹ مارٹم رپورٹ موصول ہونے کے بعد واقعے کی حتمی قانونی کارروائی اور تفتیش کو آگے بڑھایا جائے گا۔ حکام کے مطابق تمام پہلوؤں کا غیر جانبدارانہ جائزہ لیا جا رہا ہے تاکہ حقیقت سامنے آ سکے۔

stories.title: Fired Navy Officer Nancy Lacore Wins Congressional Seat
stories.summary:
Nancy Lacore, a former senior Navy officer who was dismissed from her military post by Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, has secured a victory in South Carolina’s 1st Congressional District midterm elections. Defeating Republican Jenny Costa Honeycutt, the 35-year Navy veteran and Democrat flipped the district to Democratic control, setting up a remarkable political dynamic that could place her in a position to scrutinize the Pentagon leadership that previously removed her.

Lacore's removal occurred in August 2025 during a wider leadership shake-up under Hegseth, which saw several high-ranking officers depart without a clear public explanation from the Pentagon. Rather than withdrawing from public life, Lacore launched a political campaign centered around criticizing Hegseth's leadership, publicly calling him unqualified and arguing that his actions had severely damaged the military by dismantling upper-level leadership.

Although she is not expected to take part in the current impeachment vote, her arrival in Congress in January could prove significant. Democrats may pursue further investigations or accountability measures against Hegseth, giving Lacore a direct legislative voice over the chain of command that previously ousted her from military service.

This electoral outcome matters because it creates an unusual intersection between military personnel decisions and congressional oversight. As a newly elected lawmaker, Lacore transitions from being subject to Pentagon leadership to potentially holding oversight authority over Defense Secretary Hegseth amid ongoing legislative battles and impeachment momentum.

stories.title: Deadly Ukrainian Drone Attack Hits Smolensk While Leningrad Faces Massive Strike
stories.summary:
Two individuals lost their lives in a substantial Ukrainian drone strike targeting Russia's Smolensk region, as reported on Wednesday by Governor Vasily Anokhin. According to Anokhin, air defense units managed to shoot down 37 drones, though debris struck a multi-story residential building in Yartsevo, igniting a fire. Emergency crews safely evacuated residents and rescued ten people from the immediate danger zone, establishing a temporary shelter while inspections take place.

Simultaneously, the Leningrad region experienced its largest drone onslaught of 2026 overnight on November 11. Governor Alexander Drozdenko stated that preliminary figures indicate 150 drones were intercepted over the area. The attack triggered a fire within the Ust-Luga port zone and left three workers with non-life-threatening injuries. This surpasses previous large-scale assaults this year, which included 145 drones on October 18 and 144 drones on June 6.

In response, the Russian Defence Ministry asserted that its ongoing aerial campaigns targeted energy infrastructure utilized by Ukraine's defense industry as well as vessels carrying military cargo. Overnight operations struck a 330-kilovolt substation in Kryvyi Rih alongside substations in Mayaki and Usatovo near Odesa, while also hitting a dry cargo ship in the Black Sea. Ukrainian officials acknowledged the strikes, noting injuries in both the Zaporizhzhia and Kharkiv districts, though neither side's claims could be independently verified.

These military developments coincide with a fresh series of United States-mediated peace negotiations between Moscow and Kyiv, which commenced on Tuesday in Abu Dhabi. Previous discussions under similar mediation took place earlier in the year across Abu Dhabi and Geneva. Meanwhile, diplomatic and security tensions persist as the conflict continues to impact civilian populations and critical infrastructure across the region.

stories.title: Daniel Radcliffe Unsure About Watching HBO's Harry Potter Adaptation
stories.summary:
Daniel Radcliffe has indicated that he may bypass HBO's upcoming television adaptation of the Harry Potter series, despite expressing enthusiasm for the young actors stepping into the franchise. In an interview with the Associated Press, the actor noted that he remains uncertain whether he will view the new show because he has already spent a considerable portion of his life immersed in the magical universe. Furthermore, he mentioned that he rarely watches television and finds committing to extended multi-hour series challenging.

The actor also discussed Dominic McLaughlin, the 12-year-old performer cast to portray Harry Potter in the upcoming adaptation. Rather than offering unsolicited guidance, Radcliffe emphasized that he wants the young star to forge his own distinct path without external pressure or influence. Having already exchanged welcoming letters where he encouraged McLaughlin to fully enjoy the journey, Radcliffe expressed confidence that the newcomer will deliver an exceptional performance.

Radcliffe famously portrayed the iconic wizard across eight feature films released between 2001 and 2011, achieving worldwide fame through the role. The upcoming HBO series will feature an entirely new cast to retell the beloved stories for a modern audience. Although Radcliffe likely will not tune in for the new adaptation, his supportive stance underscores his desire for the next generation of performers to claim the characters as their own.

stories.title: Pakistan Remittances Surge 14 Percent in Four Months
stories.summary:
Workers’ remittances to Pakistan increased by 13.8 percent year-on-year in October, driving cumulative growth up to 14 percent during the first four months of fiscal year 2027. According to data released by the State Bank of Pakistan (SBP), overseas Pakistanis contributed $3.9 billion in October alone, marking an 8.5 percent increase compared to September and putting inflows securely on track to meet the central bank's annual target of $45 billion.

Cumulatively, inflows reached $14.8 billion between July and October of FY27, compared to $13 billion during the same period in the previous year. This ongoing financial resilience follows a strong fiscal year 2026 where inflows surpassed $41 billion, reinforcing remittances as the country's most vital source of foreign exchange. The growth has persisted despite concerns that prolonged conflicts in the Gulf region could negatively impact the employment and earnings of millions of Pakistani workers abroad.

Geographically, Saudi Arabia remained the leading source of remittances during the four-month period, contributing $3.668 billion with a 16.5 percent increase. The United Kingdom demonstrated the highest growth rate among major destinations, rising 19.2 percent to $2.226 billion, while inflows from the United Arab Emirates grew 13.5 percent to $3.051 billion. Additional contributions came from European Union countries at $1.866 billion, other Gulf Cooperation Council countries at $1.374 billion, and the United States at $1.259 billion.

These steady financial inflows are critically important for Pakistan's macroeconomy, buffering foreign exchange reserves against regional instability. They also reflect a broader trend of increased worker departures over the past three years, highlighting the economic reliance on both expatriate labor markets and government manpower export policies.

stories.title: پاکستان اور ورلڈ لبرٹی فنانشل کے روابط پر امریکی سیاست میں گرما گرمی
stories.summary:
امریکہ کے منتخب صدر ڈونلڈ ٹرمپ کے خاندان سے وابستہ کرپٹو کمپنی ورلڈ لبرٹی فنانشل کو اب سیاسی اور قانونی دباؤ کا سامنا ہے۔ ڈیموکریٹ رہنماؤں نے عندیہ دیا ہے کہ وہ وسط مدتی انتخابات میں کامیابی کے بعد کانگریس کے اختیارات کا استعمال کرتے ہوئے ٹرمپ خاندان کے اس کرپٹو کاروبار اور اس کے غیر ملکی روابط کی باقاعدہ تحقیقات کریں گے۔ اس کمپنی کی بنیاد ٹرمپ کے بیٹوں اور مشرق وسطیٰ کے لیے امریکی خصوصی ایلچی کے بچوں نے رکھی تھی۔ 

دوسری جانب پاکستان ورچوئل اثاثہ جات ریگولیٹری اتھارٹی (پی وی اے آر اے) نے وضاحت کی ہے کہ ورلڈ لبرٹی فنانشل کے ساتھ پاکستان کا تعلق صرف تکنیکی تعاون اور مالیاتی نظام کے مستقبل کے امکانات کا جائزہ لینے تک محدود ہے۔ سنہ 2025 میں پاکستان میں کرپٹو کونسل کے قیام کے بعد اپریل میں ایک لیٹر آف انٹینٹ پر دستخط کیے گئے، اور پھر چودہ جنوری 2026 کو وزیراعظم شہباز شریف اور چیف آف ڈیفینس فورسز فیلڈ مارشل عاصم منیر کی موجودگی میں ایک مفاہمتی یادداشت پر دستخط کیے گئے۔

میڈیا رپورٹس کے مطابق کرپٹو منصوبے ڈونلڈ ٹرمپ کی آمدنی کا ایک بڑا ذریعہ بن چکے ہیں اور انہوں نے سنہ 2025 کے دوران کرپٹو کاروبار سے ایک ارب بیالیس کروڑ ڈالر سے زائد کی آمدنی ظاہر کی۔ اس کمپنی میں کرپٹو ارب پتی جسٹن سن اور متحدہ عرب امارات کے شاہی خاندان سے وابستہ سرمایہ کاروں کی طرف سے بھی بھاری سرمایہ کاری کی گئی ہے۔ 

ٹرمپ نے اس کمپنی سے لاتعلقی کا اظہار کرتے ہوئے کہا ہے کہ یہ ان کے بیٹے چلاتے ہیں اور مفادات کے ٹکراؤ کے ایسے سوالات ہر امریکی صدر کے ساتھ وابستہ رہے ہیں۔ تاہم ناقدین کا کہنا ہے کہ غیر ملکی سرمایہ کاری اور حکومتی عہدے کے درمیان تعلق کی وجہ سے یہ معاملہ اب کانگریس کی تحقیقات کا اہم ہدف بنتا جا رہا ہے۔

stories.title: US Appeals Court Rules SpaceX Must Face Harassment Lawsuit
stories.summary:
A federal appeals court in San Francisco has ruled that SpaceX must face a lawsuit accusing the company of unlawfully firing eight engineers who raised concerns about alleged sexual harassment and discrimination. The 9th US Circuit Court of Appeals rejected SpaceX's bid to push the dispute into private arbitration, upholding a lower federal judge's decision that the claims are exempt from the arbitration agreements signed by the employees.

Spokespeople for SpaceX did not immediately respond to requests for comment following the decision, while the engineers' attorney, Laurie Burgess, expressed delight with the court's ruling. The litigation stems from a 2024 lawsuit filed after the engineers circulated a letter characterizing CEO Elon Musk as a distraction and an embarrassment, while urging corporate executives to disavow sexually charged remarks he made on social media. The legal complaint asserts that Musk's behavior fostered a pervasive sexist culture where female engineers regularly encountered harassment and sexist remarks, allegations that SpaceX has consistently denied.

In its decision, the 9th Circuit dismissed the company's argument that the specific claims fell outside federal legislation permitting individuals to pursue court action in sexual harassment disputes regardless of prior arbitration clauses. This legal hurdle keeps the underlying workplace conduct allegations open to judicial scrutiny rather than confidential arbitration.

This ruling is significant because it allows former employees to challenge corporate employment practices publicly in court rather than behind closed doors. It also underscores ongoing legal challenges concerning workplace culture, executive conduct, and the enforcement of mandatory arbitration agreements within major technology and aerospace companies.

stories.title: Pakistani Government Criticized for Superficial Use of Artificial Intelligence
stories.summary:
Pakistan's government agencies and ministries are increasingly utilizing artificial intelligence to create routine social media infographics, captions, and static images. Critics argue that instead of serving as a thoughtful design tool, AI is being deployed superficially to produce generic, clichéd visual content on the first attempt without proper art direction or careful review.

This trend reflects a broader national pattern where developing countries have achieved easy access to world-class technology tools, yet often prioritize high quantity over high quality in public communications. While brands face immediate customer feedback for poor visual choices, official government channels risk undermining their own public messaging when they fail to ensure basic accuracy and depth in digital graphics.

Effective communication requires deliberate human effort, as demonstrated by creative international examples or regional administrative initiatives focused on accessibility. For instance, India launched its BHASHINI platform in 2022 to handle voice-based and text translation across dozens of local languages, assisting citizens in far-flung areas with low literacy.

Experts suggest that Pakistan could similarly harness AI to translate complex government policies into simple text and audio across its more than 60 distinct languages. Until official bureaus incorporate human oversight into their digital workflows, government social media outputs will likely continue to rely on repetitive, generic templates.

stories.title: Former State Bank Governor Examines Root Causes of Economic Inequality
stories.summary:
Growing economic inequality has become a critical challenge, driven by a widening gap in how income, wealth, opportunities, and economic power are distributed. Household consumption data shows the Gini coefficient increasing from 28.4 in the 2018-2019 period to 32.7 in 2024-2025, a figure that fails to fully capture the true scale of wealth concentration among the richest households.

Economic growth has heavily favored sectors requiring specialized skills, capital, and advanced technology, such as banking, telecommunications, IT, and energy. Because the state has fallen short in providing quality education and healthcare, disadvantaged segments are largely locked out of these expanding fields, passing economic hardships down across multiple generations. Simultaneously, state-provided protections, high import duties, subsidies, and regulatory concessions have shielded favored businesses from true market competition.

This protective system encourages powerful business groups to lobby for special privileges and form cartels rather than investing in efficiency, innovation, or export-oriented markets. Furthermore, the tax structure places a heavy burden on salaried workers while treating property earnings and capital gains more favorably, compounding wealth disparities through state-allocated public land and discretionary contracts.

Ultimately, these structural imbalances skew domestic demand toward luxury imports and foreign services, fueling recurring external deficits. Addressing these issues requires dismantling state-granted monopolies and establishing transparent, rule-based processes that reward genuine productivity rather than political connections.

stories.title: Israeli Strikes Kill Seven in Gaza While West Bank Violence Escalates
stories.summary:
Israeli military actions across the Gaza Strip resulted in the deaths of at least seven Palestinians on Tuesday, including a father and his 13-year-old son. Local medics reported that Fadi Rajab and his son Abubakr were killed when an airstrike struck a displacement shelter in Gaza City's Zeitoun neighborhood. Additional strikes and gunfire in Gaza City, Daraj, Khan Younis, and the Sabra neighborhood brought the day's death toll to at least seven.

In the occupied West Bank, Palestinian officials reported that Israeli forces shot and killed 14-year-old Moutaz Eyad Daghlas in Burqa, northwest of Nablus, following alleged stone-throwing. The Palestine Red Crescent Society stated that troops also blocked medical access to another wounded individual and detained three volunteer paramedics during the incident. Human rights groups note a sharp rise in casualties among minors in the territory since late 2023.

Meanwhile, international agencies warned of severe humanitarian and environmental hazards as winter rains began to flood displaced persons camps. Unicef officials stated that Israeli authorities recently rejected a $3 million project to repair the damaged Sheikh Radwan stormwater basin in Gaza City. Without repairs, the sewage-contaminated facility risks overflowing into tent encampments, threatening thousands of displaced residents with severe disease outbreaks.

Heavy rainfall has already caused severe flooding in tent cities across Gaza, collapsing embankments and displacing families further. United Nations representatives emphasized that urgent infrastructure rehabilitation is vital to prevent additional avoidable casualties amid ongoing regional instability.

stories.title: United States Boycotts United Nations Human Rights Review for Second Time
stories.summary:
The United States boycotted a United Nations review of its human rights record for the second consecutive time on Tuesday, leaving its delegation seats empty at the European headquarters in Geneva. The Universal Periodic Review evaluates all 193 UN member states every four to five years, making the complete non-compliance by Washington an unprecedented occurrence in the history of the Human Rights Council.

UN Human Rights Council president Sidharto Reza Suryodipuro formally noted the absence of the US delegation as the session commenced. The decision follows the Trump administration's return to power in January 2025, after which Washington halted cooperation with the rights council, dismissing it as an irredeemable body that undermines human rights. The council had previously postponed the American review by a year in hopes that the United States would eventually participate.

Despite the empty seats, civil society organizations, rights advocates, and domestic figures gathered in Geneva to highlight alleged U.S. human rights violations. Among them was Noor Abdalla, whose husband Mahmoud Khalil faced deportation attempts by the administration last year, emphasizing the necessity of global governmental accountability.

International diplomats expressed sharp reactions to the boycott during the council proceedings. While European Union representatives voiced regret over the lack of engagement, Cuban ambassador Rodolfo Benitez Verson strongly condemned Washington's absence, criticizing what he described as double standards and hypocrisy from the world's most powerful government.

stories.title: Liverpool Winger Rio Ngumoha Sets Sights on Ballon d'Or After Harry Kane's Win
stories.summary:
Liverpool winger Rio Ngumoha revealed that Harry Kane's historic Ballon d'Or victory has motivated him to pursue football's most prestigious individual accolade. Kane secured the award last month, becoming the first English player to claim the honor since Michael Owen did so in 2001. Speaking to British media, the 18-year-old forward noted that seeing a compatriot reach the pinnacle of world football serves as a powerful source of motivation for a new wave of English athletes.

Ngumoha, who recently earned a call-up to the England squad for upcoming Nations League fixtures against Croatia and Spain, expressed confidence in his own potential. He stated that Kane's success proves an English player can be recognized as the global standard, fueling his ambition to achieve the same feat. The teenager has enjoyed a rising profile following impressive performances for Liverpool last season, including a memorable contribution to their dramatic 4-3 Champions League comeback victory over Villarreal.

Having made his senior international debut in June, Ngumoha has already earned three caps for England. The national team is set to host Croatia at Wembley Stadium before traveling to Madrid to square off against world champions Spain. As Ngumoha continues to develop at both club and international levels, he remains focused on turning his ultimate career aspirations into reality.

stories.title: Mumbai Indians Trade Hardik Pandya to Punjab Kings for Arshdeep Singh
stories.summary:
Ahead of the upcoming Indian Premier League season, the Mumbai Indians have traded their captain, Hardik Pandya, to the Punjab Kings in exchange for left-arm fast bowler Arshdeep Singh. Tournament organisers announced the trade on Wednesday, marking a significant roster change as franchises prepare for the next edition of the Twenty20 competition.

Pandya has served as Mumbai's captain since 2024, securing four IPL titles across two separate stints with the five-time championship franchise. Before returning to Mumbai, he also captained the Gujarat Titans for two seasons, leading them to a victory in their 2022 debut. Meanwhile, Arshdeep moves to Mumbai after spending eight seasons with Punjab, where he will team up with Jasprit Bumrah in the pace attack.

Franchises must submit their official retention and release lists by November 17. Following this deadline, a mini-auction is scheduled to take place in Goa on December 16.

Although official fixtures have not yet been released, the 20th season of the IPL is anticipated to run from March through May of next year.

stories.title: Three Dead After Vehicle Crashes into Pedestrians in Los Angeles
stories.summary:
A devastating incident occurred in the North Hollywood district of Los Angeles on Tuesday when a vehicle plowed into a group of pedestrians, resulting in three fatalities and leaving at least three other individuals critically injured. According to the Los Angeles Fire Department, the crash took place shortly before 6 p.m. PST.

Local television station KCAL-TV reported that the car struck a food stand situated near a bus stop. The three critically injured victims were promptly transported to area hospitals for emergency medical treatment following the sudden collision.

At the time of the reports, official details regarding the exact circumstances surrounding the crash were not immediately available from authorities. The Los Angeles Fire Department provided updates regarding the transport of the injured via an online statement.
